title: Myopia Control Efficacy of Grid Dimension Multiregion Spectacle Lenses: A One-Year Randomized Double-Masked Controlled Trial

groups.description: grid dimension multiregion (GDM) myopia-control spectacle lenses (9 mm central zone, 13 annular zones of microlenses and microcylindrical lenses), worn at least 12 h daily; randomised arm; tabulated set = children who completed the 12-month visit; mean age tbl-0001!R2C2
highly aspherical lenslets (HAL) myopia-control spectacle lenses, worn at least 12 h daily; randomised arm; tabulated set = children who completed the 12-month visit; mean age tbl-0001!R2C3

exclusions.reason: not tabulated; the completers set holds at least 70% of each randomised arm (protocol inclusion 5), so it is admitted

exclusions.what: Table 2 columns C4 and C5 (p-values, between-group differences with 95% CI)
exclusions.reason: p-values and between-group differences are not admissible

exclusions.what: Table 3 and the GEE-adjusted mean changes in the Results text
exclusions.reason: model-adjusted estimates (generalized estimating equations) are not admissible
proportions are not admissible; figures are not cited

notes: Prospective randomised double-masked trial at the Hangzhou Campus of the Eye Hospital of Wenzhou Medical University, China (recruitment December 2022 to July 2023); 150 children aged 6-13 years randomised 1:1 to GDM or HAL spectacle lenses; no single-vision arm.

Analysis set: only participants who completed all visits (131 of 150). Per arm: GDM 62 completed and 13 withdrew (75 randomised), HAL 69 completed and 6 withdrew (75 randomised); reasons: refusal of cycloplegia, missed visits, lost contact, chose other myopia control methods.
Device: Tomey OA-2000 optical biometer (device class 'other'). Units: millimetres.
Table 2 gives unadjusted mean +/- SD changes from baseline at 6 and 12 months; the baseline axial length of the same completers is in Table 1 and is the reference of each change series.
Spherical equivalent refraction (cycloplegic, Topcon KR-800) is tabulated and not extracted.
